# libxslt / xslt

libxslt's own fuzz target `xslt` ([source](source/xslt.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libxslt (gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxslt at ec95343e).

Parses fuzzed stylesheet + source document, xsltParseStylesheetUser then xsltApplyStylesheetUser with op/depth limits and allocation limits, serializes the result with xsltSaveResultToString; output is freed unexamined.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libxslt at commit ec95343e.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libxslt` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `xslt.plain` | 1,111,584 | `cbfe061aa29724b90c82372354d309539a8b10afff8f64d85569e4d1747b3c2d` |
| ubsan | `xslt.ubsan` | 1,145,384 | `7e431d0c184a5083939dd61e0236ffb0d89a2b472897dd06f86f4af2b3b8edfc` |
| asan | `xslt.asan` | 2,001,592 | `7ef4253fdee571abdead227b41cc6fcf6cf01bab3f8c21d897c97efe5f1f7686` |
| asan-ubsan | `xslt.asan-ubsan` | 2,032,312 | `17fa804719bfe7bed416d775a3af1b7ab21b3c91a9399e75c022395139f7c84e` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libxml2.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libxml2.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libxml2.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `liblzma.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libxml2.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
